messages:
emma: Quick update 1: weve promoted the hosted streaming + tool-calling stack to STABLE for general use. This includes new observability hooks, a changed default backoff policy, and improved soft rate limiting. Rolling to prod now. :tada:
mike: Great! For latency-sensitive apps, what should we watch for?
emma: TL;DR: 1) built-in request-level tracing (prefix sampling), 2) default batching_window reduced to 10ms for realtime routes, 3) a soft-rate-limit layer that surfaces 429s earlier to prevent tail latency spikes. Full details below.
sarah: Ops note 1: traces will emit new span tags: service=hosted-streaming, route_id, model_variant. Staging starts collecting in ~30m. Ping @eng-sre to opt-out.
emma: Ops toggle example: ```bash
# disable prefix sampling for a route
curl -X POST "$REDWOOD_API/admin/routes/ROUTE_ID/config" -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" -d '{"prefix_sampling": false}'
```
mike: Will the soft-rate-limit increase 429s we see?
emma: You might see 429s earlier, but we expect fewer OOMs/timeouts and smoother p95s. Added metric: queue_length_breakdown per model_variant to help diagnose.
david: Legal: does changing default backoff affect customer SLAs? We need to notify if behavior changes.
emma: This is an ops-side default only; SLAs are unchanged. We'll post a customer-facing note and offer a 30-day opt-out for Dedicated tenants.
natalie: CS will draft the notice and a console banner template within 24h.
oliver: Any deprecations tied to this? We still have customers on the old websocket multiplexer.
emma: Yes 1: legacy ws-mux will be deprecated in 90 days. It will keep working but won't receive new instrumentation. Migration guide (ws -> unified-stream) will be published this afternoon.
mike: What's the rollout plan? Canary then region expansion?
emma: Canary in us-west-2 at 10% in ~20m, monitor for 6 hours, then region-wide if healthy. Rollback hooks exist.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: hosted-streaming v1.4 promoted to canary in us-west-2 1build 2026.03.21.15421 status: in-progress
sarah: I'll watch p95 latency and queue_length_breakdown. Auto-rollback triggers: p95 > 220ms OR queue > 500.
mike: I'll keep an eye on cold-start errors for quantized variants.
emma: If you see client regressions, post route_id + minimal repro here and well triage quickly. :pray:
natalie: I have 12 Dedicated customers on legacy ws; I'll start outreach tomorrow to schedule migration calls.
david: I'll review the notice before send.
emma: Summary: streaming/tool-calling marked stable, new tracing, lower default batching_window for realtime routes, soft-rate-limits, legacy ws deprecation in 90 days, canary starting now. Customer notice + migration guide forthcoming. Thanks all. :rocket:
